variants.name: Climate Dial
texts:
Circle()
    .trim(from: 0, to: progress)
    .stroke(.blue, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 6, lineCap: .round))
    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
    .overlay(Text("\(temp)°").font(.title2.bold()))
    .gesture(RotationGesture().onChanged { angle in
        progress = angle.degrees / 360
    })

CustomPaint(
  painter: DialPainter(progress: progress, color: Colors.blue),
  child: Center(
    child: Text('$temp°', style: const TextStyle(
      fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
  ),
)
72°
